prompt: Black learns to share the red truck
title: Our Red Truck
irony: Black keeps the red truck all to himself and ends up with no one to move it with, so the truck only rolls when everyone shares the pull.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Lamp glow spills down the night street where a small red truck waits by the kerb.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Black claims the red truck for himself while Navy asks for a turn and Lilac calls the path rules.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Lilac allows one driver at a time, Black hogs the seat, and the piled-high truck sticks fast.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The friends sing the red-truck chant and push the stuck truck under the lamps.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Black piles every toy aboard for one grand pull, and the heavy truck refuses to budge.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Jade dares a turbo tug, the rope jerks, toys fly, and Black sits giggling in the pile.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The friends sing the red-truck chant again, rocking the piled truck but sharing nothing yet.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gold confesses hoarding diner pancakes and learning that keeping leaves the table empty.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gold offers half his pancakes for the road while Black asks for one more seat aboard.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The friends sing the chant while Gold turns the last line, and everyone pulls the truck together.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The friends sing the hook, lamp glow spills down the changed street, and drivers swap each block.
